method: Fresh actual PNG inspection of all four proof007 contact sheets, comprising204 scheduled images. Scores were newly assigned for this run, not transferred from005/006. Earlier seed-slot familiarity means this rerun is independently reviewed but not fully blinded.

scoreAnchors.1: minor variant or substantial coherence defect
scoreAnchors.2: clear evolved form or coherent readable development

scoringNotes: Endpoint/pose distinctiveness refers to the previous milestone. Intermediate distinctiveness refers to the interval's initial form and can correctly be1 early in a continuous transformation. Exact birth scores0 for distinctiveness. Pose coherence evaluates each ordered complete eight-phase group.

clearEvolution.condition: Agent perceived distinctiveness>=2 for all adjacent milestone comparisons

continuityAtLeast2.condition: Agent temporal continuity>=2 for all adjacent milestone comparisons

gateConclusion: PASS for this bounded small proof cohort: all12 adjacent transitions read as clear evolved forms with coherent intermediate material. This does not establish uniqueness for all seeds or complete product readiness.

defects.issue: Both elder endpoints approach a long-tailed raised-face family. Proportions and head treatment differ, but convergence must remain visible in the expanded diversity report.
The first transition passes at2 rather than3; the flattened armored profile and facial reorganization make it a new form, but it is the least dramatic adjacent transition in this four-seed cohort.

improvements: S01 adult-to-elder now changes from axial limbless form to quadruped rather than relying on stacked masses with awkward transitional stalks.
All inspected S01 intermediate body masses remain connected; no isolated generated satellite pixels observed.
Faces remain readable in every inspected endpoint, including hollow ring form.
limitations: One infant and four fixed neutral-care seeds only.
Actual contact sheets and complete ordered pose groups were reviewed; physical-device playback and human review were not performed.
Prior revisions of these seed slots were known, so this rerun review is not a fully blinded holdout assessment.
No cross-preset population diversity or genetic-versus-care variance claim follows from this proof.
Source-support class exclusions are verified separately by a192genome contract test; they do not by themselves prove visual distinctiveness.

comparisons.notes: A separate small head and neck develop above a disproportionately larger lower mass. This is recognizable reorganization beyond uniform enlargement.
Upright bulb becomes an elongated limbless axial body with a raised leading head and tapering curved tail. Mass distribution and support strategy both change substantially.

Limbless axial form develops a horizontal four-legged body with redistributed trunk, head, back and articulated support. The five inspected intermediate samples retain connections; the earlier detached satellites and long growth-stalk defect are absent in this route.
Compact infant becomes a tall narrow body with head above it and a two-foot stance.
Tall support form broadens into a deep round body with a prominent upper face while support anatomy is absorbed.
Filled round body opens into a hollow ring with the face preserved on a material crown. The negative-space change is substantial and readable.
Round infant becomes a broad four-legged body with separate head and neck.
Quadruped becomes a low sloping aquatic body with reduced support and a more prominent forward face. Changes are clear but less extreme than this cohort's strongest transitions.

Low aquatic body becomes an elongated tapering axial form with raised face and wave-driven motion. This is a clear evolved form but still a related horizontal family rather than a wholesale body-plan reversal.

Borderline but passes2: compact infant becomes a flattened armored profile with a changed back/shoulder contour, seam and forward facial region. Proportion redistribution plus surface organization make it more than enlargement alone.
Horizontal armored profile becomes a tall limbless column with raised face, reversing mass arrangement and support presentation.
Tall column becomes a low long-tailed body with a raised face. Its endpoint approaches seed3's form family, a diversity weakness rather than failure of this adjacent transition.
